business.description: PVP Ventures Limited (renaming to Evervie Health Limited) is transforming from a diversified legacy business into an integrated healthcare platform focused on four pillars: Cancer Care, Renal Care, Senior Care, and Women's Health. The company is redeploying capital from legacy asset monetisation into healthcare to build scalable, mission-critical assets delivering specialty care.

outlook.statement: India's healthcare transformation is just beginning. The need is vast, the opportunity is real and the time to act is now. Building an integrated healthcare enterprise that is future-ready—grounded in clinical excellence, innovation and sustainable value creation.
The company aims to build an institution that delivers high-quality specialty care for the underserved, creating sustainable long-term value for all stakeholders.
The Board believes that the proposed name Evervie Health Limited more appropriately reflects the Company's present business strategy, future growth plans and long-term vision.
The Board anticipates improved performance from ongoing real estate projects and healthcare ventures in FY 2026-27
The Company's revenue is expected to show a substantial increase as the apartments come up for sale

India remained the fastest-growing major economy with real GDP growth estimated at 7.6% for FY 2025-26; projected at 6.6-6.9% for FY 2026-27. Healthcare demand driven by ageing population, chronic disease burden, insurance expansion, and government schemes.

Company intends to scale renal care by deepening presence in existing geographies, extending hospital-partnership network into new districts, and participating in government dialysis programmes. Cancer care scaling by adding centres in districts with acute capacity gaps, in partnership with local providers and supported by government schemes. Diagnostics to scale hub-and-spoke platform. Senior care and women's health identified as future pillars for platform expansion.

The Company believes that the Indian healthcare sector is entering a period of sustained structural growth driven by demographic transformation, increasing healthcare awareness, expanding insurance coverage, technological innovation and rising demand for specialised healthcare services.
The Company will continue to focus on strengthening its healthcare platform through disciplined capital allocation, operational excellence, strategic partnerships and governance-led growth.
Oncology, renal care, diagnostics, senior care and women's health represent durable areas of demand aligned with the Company's long-term platform strategy.
